title: Welcome to my blog
body: This is the first post on this blog — mostly here to prove the plumbing works end to end: this page, the list on the blog index, the view counter, and the like button are all reading from a plain JSON file rather than hardcoded HTML.
Going forward this space will cover platform modernization, delivery leadership, and applied AI — the same themes as the rest of this site, just in longer form.
Feel free to leave a comment below if something resonates — or delete this post once you've written your real first one.
